subject: Vendor onboarding: NovusHealth banking details & remittance mapping
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda@novushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovusHealth — banking details and remittance map

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for sending over the onboarding packet earlier. Attached is our bank detail stub (novus_bank_details.pdf) and the remittance sample your team asked for. A quick summary below so your payments team can map fields into Redwood's payment flow: 

- Preferred method: ACH (ACH direct deposit).
- Wire fallback available for international and urgent payments.
- Remittance format (CSV): invoice_number,po_number,remit_reference,customer_id,amount_due. Sample string included in the attachment.

We’ve also included the point of contact for invoices/payments (payments@novushealth.com). Please confirm when you need the signed W-9 and if DocuSign is preferred for the vendor form.

Attachments: novus_bank_details.pdf

Thanks,
Linda Park
Senior Finance Operations
NovusHealth
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Linda Park <linda@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovusHealth — banking details and remittance map

Hi Linda — thanks for the stub and summary. A few quick asks so we can finalize onboarding in our AP system: 

1) Can you complete our vendor payment form (Redwood_Vendor_Payment_Form.pdf)? I’ve attached a DocuSign link here if that’s easier: https://docusign.example/abc123
2) Please attach a signed W-9 (or a scanned copy) — required to create the vendor record.
3) Confirm the exact remittance string you want on payments. Our finance team prefers a single-field remittance value up to 256 chars; if you need structured fields we map them to invoice_number|po|customer_ref|notes. Provide an exact example line (not just CSV headers).
4) Indicate whether you require ACH pre-notification or if we can run micro-deposits for verification (we typically send two micro-deposits <$0.50 within 3 business days).

We’ll assign a PO once the vendor record is created — expected timeline is 2–3 business days after we receive the completed paperwork. Marissa / Ben — looping you in to pick this up on the finance side.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

I’ll mark this thread as the onboarding thread for NovusHealth and link to HubSpot deal HD-4357 for tracking. Thanks all — welcome aboard.

Best,
